item.title: Trump proven right on Iran's long-range missile capability as regime targets US-UK base, experts say
item.summary: Experts say Iran's Diego Garcia missile launch exposes deception about range limits, and analysts warn Europe now faces a direct ballistic threat.

item.title: FDNY turns to March Madness to deliver warning on illegal hydrant parking in New York
item.summary: As March Madness excitement builds, the FDNY reminded New Yorkers not to park illegally at fire hydrants. Cars parked too close to a hydrant can cause critical delays.

item.title: Florida woman seen on video allegedly attacking pregnant driver, elderly bystander and biting police officer
item.summary: An Orlando woman is accused of punching a pregnant woman during a road rage dispute near the Mall at Millenia, then allegedly biting a police officer.

item.title: Venezuelan migrant arrested after Loyola Chicago student fatally shot near campus
item.summary: Authorities arrest a Venezuelan migrant following the shooting death of Loyola University Chicago student Sheridan Gorman, who was killed near campus.

item.title: Floor collapse at New Hampshire wedding venue leaves multiple injured, investigation underway
item.summary: A floor allegedly collapsed at a wedding venue in Tamworth, New Hampshire, injuring multiple people as fire departments and state officials respond.

item.title: MLB umpire caught on hot mic begging pitch to 'please be a strike' after catcher issues ABS challenge
item.summary: MLB's Automated Ball-Strike System had a memorable spring training moment when umpire Bill Miller's open mic caught him saying, "Please be a strike" during a challenge.

item.title: Top 5 states with the highest number of safe hospitals, according to new report
item.summary: Healthgrades chose 438 hospitals in 40 states for 2026 Patient Safety Excellence Awards, and Texas and Florida were among the top-performing states.

item.title: 11 seed Texas upsets No 3 Gonzaga in March Madness tournament to advance to the Sweet 16
item.summary: The 11th-seeded Texas Longhorns advanced to the Sweet 16 for just the second time since 2008 after a 74-68 upset win over No. 3 Gonzaga, which suffered back-to-back second-round exits.

item.title: Dead passenger allegedly stored in heated galley for 13 hours on British Airways flight, 'foul smell' reported
item.summary: A passenger reportedly died on British Airways Flight BA32, with her body stored in a heated galley for 13 hours on the Hong Kong-to-London route.

item.title: Kurt Russell and Goldie Hawn never married, deciding 43 years ago to 'have fun until we don't'
item.summary: Kurt Russell and Goldie Hawn have sustained their remarkable 43-year relationship with one guiding motto: "Let's have fun until we don't," he reveals.
